game.name: Supreme Commander 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: The acclaimed futuristic strategy game Supreme Commander returns to Xbox 360 in this new installment, set 25 years after the events of the original. The FTU, the Illuminated and the Cybrans have decided to take up arms again and have hundreds of mechanised units battle it out on vast battlefields, either in the 18 campaign missions or in a traditional skirmish mode. The game also allows you to compete with up to 7 other players in Lan or on the net.
